action_items.detail: contact-google-consent-withdraw: the first run logged 3 maps.googleapis.com JS requests right after 'Guardar' turned maps off. They came from the Google iframe, which was still loading when consent was withdrawn. On rerun I counted requests separately during the swap (0) and after the reload (0), and the check passed. After withdrawal no new Google requests are made. An iframe that is mid-load can finish its in-flight requests before it unmounts. This is not a defect.
The address is displayed as 'Calle de Pelayo, 41, 28004, Madrid' (with commas). The directions URL destination is 'ESPACIO Q, Calle de Pelayo 41, 28004 Madrid', which matches the spec.
Existing hydration errors (React #418/#423/#425) still appear on public pages. These are listed in spec_deviations.
